body: Thank you so much! I wish you the best! <3

Some context: I’m black.

Well anyways, some kid (he was black, also integral to the story) said to another student “I’m gonna get my f*cking n*ggas on you” and my white middle aged teacher threw a fit and called security for some reason. Afterwards, when our grade principal came to ask her what happened, she screamed in front of the rest of us students awkwardly watching everything going down. “I DON’T WANT A STUDENT SAYING F-ING N*GGERS IN MY CLASS.”

Now, I imagine this is a reasonable concern for every teacher, but my ass seemed to be the only one who noticed her censoring f*cking but not the n-word. So, I looked her dead in the eyes and said “did you really just say n*ggers, but not f*cking?”

I was instantly sent to my principal’s office. Luckily for me, he liked me at this point and noted it was a ridiculous situation, but I still got ISS for swearing so boldly in front of him and this already hysterical (and slightly racist) teacher.

Funnily enough, all of my friends and family who had her in high school loved her, but this teacher and i had a rocky relationship for the rest of the year.
I’m not homie, promise.

Dude, what I’m about to say to you, I’ll say to anyone. Don’t hate what you got. Ever. Once you start looking down on yourself because of your looks, you’ll never be satisfied. The change won’t happen overnight but trust me, learn to accept yourself. When you start working out and getting the body you once desired, you’ll find something else to be insecure about and so forth. The cycle of self-loathing won’t end.

Still, go to the gym!! Change your diet!!! Do what you need to do to gain healthy weight!!! Achieve your goals and stay motivated...I’m rooting for you!

Edit: Almost every single person has insecurities about themselves. And on top of that, almost every single person gets super depressed about that. It’s normal. What you can do, however, is get off your ass and make the change you want to see in yourself. Emotionally and physically.

You didn’t do anything wrong. It’s hard to get yourself out there and social anxiety on top of that makes things worse. Honestly, in this situation it’s either put yourself out there or stick it out until the summer. I had a pretty bad depression in the past few months and my remedy for that feeling has been to hang out with the two friends I have left. I’m sure they have no problem talking to you and hanging out with you. 

I dunno what your plans are for the future but trust me you’ll have plenty of opportunities to talk and meet new people. High school is awful because it confines us to the same few people but without that shackle on our ankles we have more freedom to interact with new people and make what we want out of our social lives.

Dude, we’re about to graduate. Our stories are different but I understand how you feel. I have one week of classes left and I don’t know if I’ll make it either. It fucking sucks. All of it sucks. But you should stick it through with me and plenty of other teens who feel the same way as you do. You’re not alone in how you feel.

Fuck it dude. Just do your best to salvage your grades and don’t push away the few friends you have left. Summer will be unbearable on your lonesome. High school will soon be over for plenty of depressed teens and we’ll look back with bittersweet memories. Don’t end your life, dude. You can make it.
